workRef.description: DEPRECATED: use #ref with type 'work'. Reference to an artwork/creative work. At least one resolvable ID or a descriptive fallback (title). Readers map it to #ref as { type: work, role: subject, descriptor: { label: title, creator, creatorDid, date }, externalIds: [wikidata, linkedArt, accession] }.

creatorDid.description: DID of the creative who made this work, when known. The `creator` string remains the descriptive fallback.

placeRef.description: A venue with an ATProto identity, or an ad-hoc named place.

did.description: Venue DID if it has an ATProto account

precision.description: Declared coordinate fuzzing level. Coordinates MUST already be fuzzed to this precision before the record leaves Tier 0.

mediaRef.description: Tier 0/1 media reference. Replaced by an imageRef at promotion time; alt text and aspectRatio carry across unchanged.

aspectRatio.description: Pixel dimensions, so a reader can reserve layout space before the image bytes arrive. Shape matches app.bsky.embed.images#aspectRatio.

imageRef.description: A published image and the two things a reader needs to present it honestly: what it shows, and how much room it takes. Field names match app.bsky.embed.images#image and the community standalone-image proposal, so this can become a ref to a shared lexicon without changing the published payload.

alt.description: What the image shows. Absent means absent — readers must not substitute a title.

mutualMint.description: True if created by a mutual-press ceremony

mintId.description: Device-generated mint identifier (hex). Shared between both parties' beads on a mutual mint — the encounter join key.

timeAnchored.description: False when the device knew only the time-of-day or nothing; createdAt is then a best guess

linkRef.description: External link attached to a bead or strand: event page, venue page, ticket listing.

externalId.description: An identifier for this subject in another system. Registries are peers: no scheme is privileged, and knownValues is advisory so new schemes need no schema change.

uri.description: Resolvable URL for this identifier, where one exists.

ref.description: What an entry is about, or reaches for, as data beside the text. Modelled on app.bsky.richtext.facet: the text is never rewritten, and `index` is a UTF-8 byte range into the record's own text (strand.narrative; bead.note; annotation.note). Identity is descriptor + did + externalIds. No AppView cluster id is ever part of a ref.

role.description: subject: what the record is about. mention: invoked, compared, gestured at. Readers treat any other value as mention.

did.description: DID of the referent itself (a person, a venue with an account). A work's maker goes in descriptor.creatorDid.

refDescriptor.description: The portable description of a referent: enough to cluster on when no identifier exists. Deliberately has no free-text note.

label.description: Title of a work, name of a person, venue, event or concept.

byteSlice.description: Same shape as app.bsky.richtext.facet#byteSlice: zero-indexed UTF-8 byte offsets, end exclusive. Text length limits elsewhere are in graphemes; these are bytes.

presentation.description: How the work was encountered: the manifestation, as distinct from the work. Two beads can share a work ref and differ here.

venueRef.description: A reference to a venue, never a location: carries no coordinates.

didRef.description: A person or organisation by DID, with a descriptive fallback name.

creditRef.description: A named contributor. `role` is deliberately freeform: role vocabularies differ per industry and belong in referencing layers, not in this schema.
